description: Coin Flip, a signed cancel before the first move: the PlayerCancel EIP-712 message of the round in snapshot/valid/coinflip-active-ready-hash (its domain, its roundId as round, its readyHash T_0 as previous), whose typedData is snapshot/typed-data/coinflip-cancel, signed by the round's action key. structHash is T_1. The hashes, digest and signature were made with Foundry cast alone (generatedWith), not with the engine's own EIP-712 code, so a shell that reproduces them agrees with an independent signer. testKey is a public test key: never use it for anything of value.
encodeType: PlayerCancel(string action,uint8[] path,uint32 sequence,bytes32 round,bytes32 previous)

testKey.note: TEST KEY ONLY. The well-known account at index 3 of the default anvil and Hardhat test mnemonic, public by design; never fund it or use it outside tests. Its address is the round's actionKey.

generatedWith.input: player-cancel.json holds the eip712 member of this vector.
commands: cast keccak 'PlayerCancel(string action,uint8[] path,uint32 sequence,bytes32 round,bytes32 previous)'

cast keccak $(cast abi-encode 'f(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32,uint256,address)' $(cast keccak 'EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)') $(cast keccak SuperEngine) $(cast keccak 1) 31337 0x5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e)

cast keccak $(cast abi-encode 'f(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32,uint32,bytes32,bytes32)' 0xacaf7a5ad98f54f1cf2ba32c94a782121894bc4306dbb28b7683c5ef579a9ce6 $(cast keccak cancel) $(cast keccak 0x) 1 0x01927c5e8b3a7f219c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d00000000000000000000000000000000 0x1bb96dc769cd08816e9ed82a7155b464b2730a9df1d46bdf86dabf94485fc510)
generatedWith.outputs: The commands print, in order: the address (EIP-55 cased), typeHash, domainSeparator, structHash, digest, and the signature twice. Both signing commands print the same signature, so cast's own EIP-712 digest of the input equals digest.
